steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters for the AgriSeq Part 4 pooling protocol in the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map: Opentrons 96‑filter tip rack (20 µL), Opentrons 96‑filter tip rack (200 µL), ThermoFisher Scientific 96‑well plate (200 µL, catalog AB‑0800 or 4483352), and the Opentrons P20 and P300 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the positions of the labware, tip racks, and the single‑channel pipettes (P20 and P300).

steps.title: Pool samples and transfer
steps.instruction: The robot will pool the samples from the source plate into 60 µL pools in a well plate, then transfer 45 µL from each pool into the final processing plate.

substeps.instruction: Create 60 µL pools in designated wells of a 96‑well plate.
Transfer 45 µL from each pool to the final processing plate.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the pooling protocol.
